review_text: Went here Jan. 18, 2026. Had our first caffeine area since getting back in Davao (airplane coffee does not count) …
Good drinks, cozy atmosphere. Even has a perfume collection you can try out. Perfect for chilling and intimate conversations, would definitely visit another time
